product_one_liner.value: Vectary is a browser-based design platform for designers and business teams to develop concepts with AI and create, share, and embed interactive 3D presentations, product configurators, and augmented-reality experiences.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 18 employees as of May 31, 2026; the company profile also reports 18. Counts differ across directories.

hq_location.notes: Corporate headquarters; some directories instead describe its Slovak operating base in Bratislava.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains product announcements, design tutorials, and marketing content, rather than two engineer-authored posts about building the platform.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public jobs listing states “No jobs to discover at this time.” No qualifying live vacancy was found.

model_provider.value: Hunyuan 3.1; Hunyuan 3; Tripo H3.1; Tripo 2.5; Pixal 3D; Trellis 2; Trellis; Meshy 6; Meshy 5; Rodin 2
model_provider.notes: These are the AI models explicitly listed as available for image-to-3D generation, not inferred provider identities.

compliance_certs.notes: The company claims SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a regulation, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights identifies the latest round as $4.6 million on January 25, 2023; a January 2023 SEC Form D corroborates financing in that month.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is January 25, 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public jobs listing states “No jobs to discover at this time.” No qualifying live vacancy was found.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 20, 2026, Vectary added new AI image-to-3D models, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Roberto A.’s public profile dates his Vectary Chief Revenue Officer tenure January 2023–May 2026, establishing a departure within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Vectary explicitly names HubSpot among its service providers; this is a vendor-use signal, not evidence of a customer-facing CRM integration.
